description: Fix 7 integration issues identified in code review: URL path mismatch, content-type mismatch, coherence fail-open, no persistence, knowledge upload no-op, no API key validation, and state-of-art checkbox logic
steps: Add /api prefix to all backend routers in main.py to match frontend expectations
Simplify nginx.conf to only proxy /api/ and /health (all routes are under /api now)
Change frontend submitInput to send JSON instead of multipart/form-data
Change coherence validation _parse_coherence_result default return from True to False (fail-closed)
Add PersistenceService with file-based JSON storage in data/ directory
Integrate persistence into projects and workflow routers
Fix knowledge upload to append parsed content to knowledge base documents list
Add lazy client initialization with API key validation in AIService
Add STATE_OF_ART phase handling in workflow engine with study tracking
Add state-of-art constraint check in advance endpoint
Update all integration test paths from /projects to /api/projects etc.
Add new tests for state-of-art, knowledge upload persistence, and coherence fail-closed
acceptance_criteria: Frontend requests to /api/projects reach the backend correctly
Frontend submitInput sends JSON body matching backend SubmitInputRequest model
Ambiguous AI coherence responses block advancement (fail-closed)
Projects and workflow states persist to disk and survive process restarts
Uploaded knowledge files become searchable in the knowledge base
AIService raises clear AIServiceConfigError when AI_API_KEY is empty
State-of-art requires 6 studies or no_more_studies_found flag to advance
findings: All 65 backend tests pass (59 original + 6 new). All 10 frontend tests pass. Frontend build succeeds. Persistence uses ./storage/data/ directory which is already in .gitignore. AI service now uses lazy client initialization with property pattern.
